posts.title: Dropping Out of Oxford University
posts.description: Ironically, I'm writing this post a few hours after watching Paul Graham speak live at the Oxford Union (thanks Daniel for adding me as a guest). Ironic because PG believes students should NOT drop out . Anyways, I just sent my rustication email (Oxford speak for suspending your studies). I will be working full time for a start-up. Thanks Konrad @ Hummingbird for introing me to them. UPDATE 21/06/
